prompt:
STYLE: 2D hand-drawn action comic game art, Chinese ink-wash inspired, bold dark-brown ink outlines (#2B1D16), flat colors with one hard cel-shadow tone, subtle rice-paper texture, slightly chibi proportions (head-to-body 1:3), strong readable silhouettes, ink splatter accents, top-left light source, top-down three-quarter view at 45 degrees, Late Eastern Han dynasty China setting, original designs, suitable for a top-down action roguelike.
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE bare dry-earth tile, variant 2 of four mutually mixable soil variants. Reference is palette/material guidance only, NOT the grid layout. Output one continuous seamless square of subdued grey-brown dusty packed soil, slightly darker and much greyer than the orange reference. Target mean color around sRGB (170,140,105). Hand painted dry brush strokes, fine soil grains, subtle rice-paper irregularity and a few very tiny dark brown ink scratches. Variation should be natural low-contrast granular detail all over the tile. Intended final size 128x128: avoid large forms that look like symbols or patches. No thematic objects whatsoever: NO grass, rocks, cracks, ruts, footprints, puddles, ink blotches or shadows. No dots in a grid, mosaic, geometric polygons or honeycomb. No vignette, glow, gradient, center/edge difference, frame, empty perimeter or tilesheet. A tactile neutral ground substrate, edge-to-edge, subtle uneven handmade soil texture. Not flat orange. This single square must tile in both axes, with same average lighting/color across its entire surface. No text, logo, watermark.
